name: Apple
soil_type: Well-drained, loamy soil with a slightly acidic to neutral pH (6.0 to 7.0). Avoid heavy clay soils.
light: Full sun (minimum 6 to 8 hours of direct sunlight daily). Ample sunlight needed for optimal fruit production.
water_needs: Regular watering is essential, especially during dry periods. Deep watering once or twice a week.
temperature: Temperate climates with distinct seasons; requires chilling hours (below 45°F or 7°C) during winter for flowering and fruiting.

name: Bell Pepper
water_needs: Consistent watering, especially during fruit development
temperature: Warm-season crop; grows best between 70 to 85°F (21 to 29°C)
photo_alt: Bell Pepper plant in the field

name: Blueberry
temperature: Temperate to cool climates; highbush types need winter chill

name: Cherry
scientific_name: Prunus avium (Sweet cherry), Prunus cerasus (Sour cherry)
soil_type: Well-drained, sandy or loamy soil; pH 6.0 to 7.5
temperature: Temperate climates with cold winters (for dormancy) and mild springs

name: Corn
soil_type: Well-drained, fertile loamy soils with pH between 5.8 and 7.0; heavy nitrogen feeder
light: Full sun, ideally receiving at least 6 to 8 hours of direct sunlight daily
water_needs: Consistent moisture essential, particularly during silking and tasseling. Requires ~15 inches (38 cm) during the season.
temperature: Warm temperatures between 60°F and 95°F (16°C to 35°C); frost-free season of 90 to 120 days depending on variety.

name: Grape
scientific_name: Vitis vinifera (European grape), Vitis labrusca (American grape), etc.
soil_type: Well-drained, sandy or loamy soils; pH 5.5 to 7.0
temperature: Temperate to warm climates; need hot, dry summers and mild winters

name: Orange
soil_type: Well-drained, loamy soil; pH between 6.0 to 7.0
light: Full sun (minimum 6 to 8 hours of direct sunlight daily)
water_needs: Regular, deep watering; keep soil consistently moist but not waterlogged. Allow the top inch of soil to dry between waterings.
temperature: Warm, subtropical to tropical climates; ideal temperature range: 68 to 85°F (20 to 29°C). Sensitive to frost; protection needed in cooler regions.

name: Peach
soil_type: Well-drained, loamy or sandy soil with a pH between 6.0 and 7.0
light: Full sun (minimum 6 to 8 hours of direct sunlight daily)
water_needs: Consistent moisture, especially during the first two years; avoid overwatering to prevent root rot
temperature: Temperate climates with cold winters; requires 600 to 900 chilling hours below 45°F (7°C) for optimal fruiting

name: Potato
soil_type: Well-drained, loose, and friable soils rich in organic matter. Sandy loam and loamy soils are ideal. pH 5.0 to 6.5
light: Full sun; requires at least 6 to 8 hours of direct sunlight daily for optimal growth
water_needs: Requires consistent moisture, especially during tuber formation. Ensure the soil remains moist but not waterlogged.
temperature: Cool-season crop. Ideal growing temperatures range between 60 to 70°F (16 to 21°C). Sensitive to frost; plant after last frost when soil is at least 45°F (7°C).

name: Soybean
soil_type: Well-drained, fertile loamy soil; pH between 6.0 to 7.0
light: Full sun (minimum 6 to 8 hours of direct sunlight daily)
water_needs: Consistent moisture is essential, especially during flowering and pod development. Avoid waterlogging.
temperature: Warm-season crop; optimal temperature range: 70 to 95°F (21 to 35°C). Sensitive to frost; best planted after the last frost date.

name: Squash
soil_type: Well-drained, fertile loamy soil; pH between 5.8 to 6.8
light: Full sun (minimum 6 to 8 hours of direct sunlight daily)
water_needs: Regular, deep watering; keep soil consistently moist but not waterlogged. Avoid overhead watering to reduce disease risk.
temperature: Warm-season crop; optimal temperature range: 70 to 95°F (21 to 35°C). Sensitive to frost; plant after the last frost date.

name: Strawberry
water_needs: Regular moisture; do not let soil dry out completely
temperature: Cool to temperate; perform best with warm days and cool nights

name: Tomato
water_needs: Regular, deep watering (keep soil consistently moist but not soggy)
temperature: Warm-season; ideal temperature range: 70 to 85°F (21 to 29°C)
